variables.name: raf
variables.description: A serine/threonine-protein kinase that functions as a MAP kinase kinase kinase (MAP3K) in the Ras-Raf-MEK-ERK signaling cascade, transducing mitogenic and differentiation signals from the cell membrane to the nucleus.

variables.name: mek
variables.description: A dual-specificity protein kinase (MAP2K) that phosphorylates ERK1/2 on both threonine and tyrosine residues, serving as the intermediate kinase in the canonical MAPK/ERK signaling cascade.

variables.name: plc
variables.description: A phosphodiesterase enzyme that catalyzes the hydrolysis of phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate (PIP2) into inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate (IP3) and diacylglycerol (DAG), thereby initiating calcium mobilization and PKC activation.

variables.name: pip2
variables.description: A membrane phosphoinositide lipid that serves as the primary substrate of PLCγ and a precursor for the second messengers IP3 and DAG, playing a central role in phosphoinositide signaling and membrane dynamics.

variables.name: pip3
variables.description: A membrane phosphoinositide generated by phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K) that recruits pleckstrin homology (PH) domain-containing proteins such as Akt and PLCγ to the plasma membrane, acting as a key lipid second messenger in cell survival and proliferation signaling.

variables.name: erk
variables.description: A serine/threonine-protein kinase that functions as the terminal effector of the Ras-Raf-MEK-ERK cascade, phosphorylating diverse cytoplasmic and nuclear substrates to regulate cell proliferation, differentiation, and survival.

variables.name: akt
variables.description: A serine/threonine-protein kinase recruited to the plasma membrane by PIP3 and activated via phosphorylation by PDK1 and mTORC2, functioning as a central node in the PI3K-Akt-mTOR signaling axis to promote cell survival and inhibit apoptosis.

variables.name: pka
variables.full_name: PKA (Protein Kinase A / cAMP-Dependent Protein Kinase)
variables.description: A cAMP-dependent serine/threonine-protein kinase that serves as a major effector of the cAMP second messenger signaling pathway, phosphorylating a broad spectrum of downstream substrates including CREB, Raf, MEK, and components of the MAPK and stress-activated kinase pathways.

variables.name: pkc
variables.description: A family of lipid-activated serine/threonine-protein kinases that are stimulated by diacylglycerol (DAG) and calcium ions, mediating a wide array of cellular responses including MAPK cascade activation via Raf phosphorylation, and regulation of stress-activated kinases (p38, JNK).

variables.name: p38
variables.description: A stress-activated serine/threonine-protein kinase of the MAPK family that is phosphorylated by MKK3/6 in response to cellular stress, pro-inflammatory cytokines, and upstream regulators including PKA and PKC, mediating inflammation and apoptotic signaling.

variables.name: jnk
variables.description: A stress-activated serine/threonine-protein kinase of the MAPK superfamily, activated by MKK4/7 in response to cellular stress and cytokines, that phosphorylates the transcription factor c-Jun and other substrates to regulate apoptosis and inflammatory responses.
